findings.finding: The persisted controlled_since_turn_began -> Forge |SummonSick mapping is the minimum native representation needed to remove obj:P1-bears from native attacker eligibility while preserving Forge CombatUtil as sole legality authority.

findings.forge_source_finding: CombatUtil.canBlock(Card, boolean) checks creature status, phasing, tapped state and blocking restrictions but does not use summoning sickness. eligibleBlockersJson iterates every non-active defender creature and includes each semantic card that CombatUtil.canBlock(attacker, blocker, combat) accepts for at least one attacker.
findings.implication: The summoning-sickness remediation cannot legitimately remove obj:P2-bears from blocker legality. If fresh runtime emits obj:P2-bears as an eligible blocker, do not filter it in the provider/runner and do not alter native legality. Adjudicate the immutable requested state against current authority before any further implementation change.

grant runtime credit from this pre-audit
